author: ErikBurdett
subject: feat: public site with home, master change ledger, lore library and compendium
body:
Turn /updates/ into Theandril's main website inside the shared Hearth & Card
shell: a home page with a build-time ledger of every master commit (subject,
body, numstat, authored notes, permalinks), the developer dispatches moved to
/updates/dispatches/, a lore library rendered from docs/lore markdown (Book of
Broken Roads, Foundations, Faction Bible, Cohort notes) and a world compendium
projecting every culture, unit, building, improvement, resource, creature and
terrain from @theandril/content with sprites from the published atlases.

Generated content (lore/library.json, compendium/data.json, changelog/feed.json)
is produced by scripts/build-*.ts and guarded by regeneration tests; Pages
regenerates the change feed from full history before building.

Independent review: docs/development/site-expansion/review/ (original
fail-closed verdict retained; two bounded fixes; delta approved).

author: ErikBurdett
subject: fix: include reviewed journal HTML entrypoint in deployment
notes:
## Shared site shell

This checkpoint establishes the multi-page public-site structure that lets the home, dispatches, lore library and compendium use one navigation and footer shell. It keeps each page a static Vite entry so direct refreshes work on plain Pages hosting.

author: ErikBurdett
subject: feat: publish Theandril Dispatches and campaign safety development demo
notes:
## Dispatches launch

This change introduced the public developer journal: three illustrated, source-linked dispatches covering campaign safety, archive durability, and the twenty-four-culture baseline. It included searchable archive controls, stable dispatch query links, a scope ledger, source library and contributor guidance.

The journal reused retained Hearth & Card materials and four provenance-recorded game screenshots. It introduced no game rules or new game artwork; it is a development-demo publication, not 1.0 acceptance.

author: ErikBurdett
subject: Update README and various SKILL documents for Theandril, enhancing campaign instructions, refining battle mechanics, and expanding lore. Key changes include clearer campaign setup guidelines, detailed exploration and recruitment processes, and improved asset management protocols. Added new sections on resource deposits, hearth development, and sprite animation standards to ensure consistency and clarity across gameplay elements.

author: ErikBurdett
subject: feat: publish the 24-faction development campaign on GitHub Pages
body: Checkpoint integrated geography, armies, naval travel, tactical battles, faction art, and map-first campaign management. Add base-safe verified assets and automatic Pages deployment with production gameplay smoke checks. Preserve source art and release-gap evidence; stop tracking disposable browser output.
